expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Returns the engine transient package. Returns the package containing generated AngelScript types. Finds a class by AngelScript type name. Collects all loaded classes. @param OutClasses Receives the loaded class handles. Finds a loaded object by path or name. Finds a loaded object with the requested name inside Outer.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
testScope: UPackage GetTransientPackage(); | UPackage GetAngelscriptPackage(); | UClass FindClass(const FString& Name); | void GetAllClasses(TArray<UClass>& OutClasses); | UObject FindObject(const FString& Name); | UObject FindObject(UObject Outer, const FString& Name);
